name: @goblin-forge/runtime
//: The language itself, as data: the ambient global surface every Goblin
program is checked against, the tsconfig base every project extends, and
(from milestone 5) the native runtime library those programs link.
A package rather than a directory because both the compiler and the
user's editor have to resolve the same copy of global.d.ts. If the two
disagree, tsserver underlines things the compiler accepts and vice versa,
which is worse than having no editor support at all.
